payload.title: Real-replay and fault-test adaptive live fusion mesh V2 vs V3 dual-plane
payload.work_clay: Replay current repository work events, branch feedback and dependency projections through broadcast, tag-only, CLAY_LIVE_FUSION_MESH_V2_CANDIDATE and CLAY_LIVE_FUSION_MESH_V3_DUAL_PLANE_CANDIDATE. V3 emits compact ImpactBeacon control-plane metadata to all branches for material deltas, obtains BranchImpactAck from freshest distinct relevance surfaces where available, and keeps full payload sparse. Measure relevant-branch recall pre/post repair, full-payload bytes, beacon/ack bytes, invalidation/ack latency, stale window, false AFFECTED/NOT_AFFECTED, UNKNOWN/STALE rate, repair success and CPU/RAM/I/O. Inject missing central dependency edges, correlated missing edges across projections, stale epochs, duplicate deltas, dropped beacon/acks, out-of-order causal predecessors and crash/restart with open AckClosure. Do not promote from synthetic evidence.
payload.reason_clay: A new 5,000-delta matched synthetic extension improved recall from 0.963040 for V2 to 0.996230 for V3 while weighted network cost stayed 3.175708 versus 9.0 broadcast under the declared beacon-cost model. The exactly-one adversarial correlated-blind-spot experiment removed the V3 recall advantage entirely, proving that projection ancestry/provenance diversity is a required real test rather than an assumption. Fresh OSDI 2025 Picsou evidence motivates precise acknowledgement/targeted resend semantics; Enzyme 2026 motivates cost-based strategy selection. Real-repo execution remains the promotion gate.
payload.completion_clay: Real-repo report contains exact repo/commit/epoch hashes and raw matched rows for broadcast/tag-only/V2/V3; proves whether secondary relevance checks are provenance-distinct; executes missing-edge, correlated-edge, stale-epoch, duplicate, dropped beacon/ack, causal reorder and crash/restart faults; records pre/post-repair recall, permanent misses, ack latency, false relevance verdicts and exact resource/network costs; returns SUPPORTED, REFUTED, REVISE or NO_CHANGE; sends targeted branch feedback; grants no BASE or Frank Harness promotion credit by itself.
payload.executor_policy: Use first non-overlapping worker with repository checkout plus local Python/SQLite/ClayGraph capability. Refresh head/current spec_rev before effect. Do not displace the BASE ClayCode critical path on the same executor; run only with spare capacity or when directly useful to work-state projection reliability. Treat a second projection derived from the same source ancestry as correlated, not independent. No paid training and no Frank self-Harness authority.
invalidators: A newer owner-fixed mesh protocol explicitly supersedes V2/V3
A newer real execution receipt already performs the same matched V2/V3 replay and fault matrix
Current repo state proves no materially distinct relevance source exists for V3 and the dual plane cannot be tested as specified
